headword: {銀河鉄道|ぎんがてつどう}の{夜|よる}
reading: ぎんがてつどうのよる
gloss: Night on the Galactic Railroad (story by Miyazawa Kenji)

definitions.gloss: Night on the Galactic Railroad (story by Miyazawa Kenji)
definitions.explanation: A fantasy by {宮沢賢治|みやざわけんじ}, left unfinished at his death in 1933 and published the following year. A lonely boy, Giovanni, rides a train across the Milky Way with his friend Campanella, and the journey becomes a meditation on death and true happiness.
